title: Entering the Business World
description: You could either enter the business world and start your professional career or enroll to a Master's degree. The choice is yours.

Our Bachelor's in Communication also prepares you for a professional career. Our graduates have found work in private and public companies with many different functions: internal and external communication management, content production for various audiences, strategic planning of communication flows, human resources management and much more. For example, here is a list of some of the sectors in which our students are employed:

  • Media and advertising
  • Teaching, training and research
  • Industry or construction business
  • Services
  • Trade
  • IT and digital
  • Banking and insurance
  • Public administration
  • Tourism
  • Cultural institutions
  • …
